run_human_coach_cli: run the human coach CLI to play a MiniRTS game with a pretrained executor model
create_game_with_ai_bots: create a MiniRTS game with a CheatExecutorAI bot and a MediumAI opponent bot
parse_args_for_human_coach: parse command line arguments for the human coach including seed, GPU, and model path
get_game_option_from_args: build an RTSGameOption object from parsed CLI args with seed, resource, and tick settings
get_ai_option_from_args: build AI option objects for both players with frame skip, FOW, and resource bin settings
